info.name: Bank Statement Verifier
info.description:
Author: Hasan Gaffar

Requests and assertions for the Bank Statement Verification API. All sample statements are synthetic. File paths are relative to the project root, for example:

newman run postman/Bank-Statement-Verifier.postman_collection.json --working-dir . --folder "Verification" --folder "Error handling"

In the Postman app, set the working directory to the project root or re-select each file. The "AI review" folder needs an Anthropic credential in n8n and sends sample data to Anthropic. Its assertions check routing only, so they do not prove that the models answered; check aiReview.status.
